title: Number of Unique Flavors After Sharing K Candies
summary: Given an array of integers representing candy flavors, determine the maximum number of unique flavors you can retain after giving your sister a continuous segment of k candies.
statement: Given an array of integers representing candy flavors, determine the maximum number of unique flavors you can retain after giving your sister a continuous segment of k candies.
constraints: Give away exactly one contiguous segment of k candies; k may be zero or the entire array length.
Count distinct flavors remaining outside that segment.
Return the maximum possible remaining distinct count.
reference_solution:
def maximum_flavors_after_sharing(candies,k):
    from collections import Counter
    kept=Counter(candies[k:]);answer=len(kept)
    for right in range(k,len(candies)):
        kept[candies[right-k]]+=1;kept[candies[right]]-=1
        if kept[candies[right]]==0:del kept[candies[right]]
        answer=max(answer,len(kept))
    return answer

The counter always represents exactly the candies outside the current length-k segment, so its key count is the retained variety.
